section.28: The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)

28.name_native: The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)

hadiths.text: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of narrators but with a slight variation of words, i. e. he did not say:By Him besides Whom there is no god
